prompt_en: Create a photorealistic environmental portrait of one adult woman, using the attached portrait only as a guide to visible appearance: long dark wavy hair with a loose center part, dark eyes, softly shaped brows, and the overall adult facial proportions. She stands at a botanical specimen mounting bench inside a working conservation studio. In the same captured instant, her left hand pins the near edge of a folded cream paper folio against the flat bench while her right hand slides its outer fold into alignment with the straight edge of a brass ruler. The ruler lies fully supported on the bench, parallel to the folio's fold, with both hands visible on opposite sides of that fold. Her torso leans only slightly over the table, weight carried by both feet outside the frame; her face remains readable above the work surface, eyes directed toward the alignment point. A shallow tray of pressed leaves, archival labels, blotting sheets, and specimen cabinets make the room's purpose legible. Side daylight from a tall window grazes the paper fibers and brass edge; soft fill keeps her face and working fingers clear. Photograph at medium distance from table height in a restrained editorial style, with realistic skin texture, individual hair strands, fine garment creases, a faint shadow under the folio, and natural depth of field. Compose from a few steps back: the adult subject remains identifiable at environmental portrait scale through her readable face and working hands; the place has visible task-specific fixtures or objects in the pressed-leaf tray and specimen cabinets; the subject's action or position connects to those fixtures through the folio aligned at the mounting bench; the frame retains enough surrounding space to explain the task through visible worktop and cabinet context. Use a 50 mm normal lens at f/5.6, focused between her face and the work surface so both remain legible while distant cabinets soften gently.
negative_en: low resolution, body distortion, 3D render look, cartoon style, plastic-looking skin, broken facial features, fake-looking background, excessive HDR
